artifacts.note: Reviewer's independent checks (not produced by the capture script): independent checks: git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree}; git status --porcelain --ignored; git ls-files -v; shasum -a 256 on the 8 lock files; asset index vs git ls-tree -r HEAD grobid-home; shasum -a 256 on host dylib closure; DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES=1 pdfalto -v

case_counts.definition: Independently recomputed: 8 critical sha256 (shasum) + 506 asset-index (mode,type,blob) tuples vs git ls-tree + oracle HEAD, tree, clean-incl-ignored. Rerun of capture_t000.py: 65 sub-commands, 0 unexpected exits, 0 failures; manifest and host lock byte-identical to committed; report/commands identical except timestamps/cwd/log hashes.

acceptance.criterion: Isolated oracle checkout at pinned SHA; clean revision and complete build environment
acceptance.basis: HEAD f313f701, tree a59943da, 0 status lines incl. ignored, no assume-unchanged/skip-worktree, no submodules, connectivity fsck ok. Toolchain/OS/CPU/locale/TZ/Gradle recorded; Maven dependency closure, Gradle distribution hash and user-level build config deferred to T002 (findings F1, F2).

acceptance.criterion: Verify eight critical source hashes and enumerate native/model dependency closure
acceptance.basis: 8/8 sha256 match by independent shasum. 25 natives hashed and file-typed; mac_arm-64 otool/nm/codesign; host dylib closure (6 Homebrew libs) confirmed by DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES and independent sha256. 33 model dirs / 86 files enumerated with sha256. Closure is tree enumeration only, not config-to-file mapping (F3).

acceptance.criterion: Record source-derived versus runtime-unresolved fields; no fabricated digest
acceptance.basis: source_derived/runtime_observed/unresolved sections present; container_digests empty and asset runtime_sha256 null, none fabricated. Minor classification looseness (F6).

findings: F1 (minor, build env): gradle-wrapper.properties has no distributionSha256Sum; the Gradle 9.6.1 distribution downloaded by gradlew --version is not integrity-pinned and its hash is not recorded (the zip is gone from ~/.gradle/wrapper/dists, only the unpacked tree remains). Gradle Revision 309d128b... is recorded in logs/19. T002 should hash the unpacked distribution.

F2 (minor, build env): JDK identity is version strings plus the /opt/homebrew/opt symlink path; the resolved Cellar path appears only inside the gradle log and no JDK file hash is recorded. User-level build config (~/.gradle/gradle.properties, init.d, ~/.m2/settings.xml, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS/_JAVA_OPTIONS/GRADLE_OPTS) is not recorded; reviewer observed none present at review time.

F3 (minor, closure): model 'closure' is an enumeration of files in the git tree; no static map from grobid.yaml/grobid-full.yaml model names/flavors/engines to required files, and DeLFT embeddings/external downloads are not enumerated. Acceptable as source-derived inventory; config-to-asset resolution must be done in T003.

F4 (minor, script robustness): capture_t000.py does not assert len(source_hashes)==8 (an emptied lock would pass vacuously); zip(paths, rawids) does not check equal lengths; worktree_bytes_differ_from_blob_eol is reported but not a failure (mitigated by the clean-status check); pdfalto -v accepts exit 0/1/99 without asserting the version string; brew exit 1 accepted silently; @rpath and @executable_path deps of the top-level natives are skipped (no real loss here: libwapiti's only @rpath entry is its own install name); post-gradle status check omits --ignored (reviewer confirmed 0 ignored files after rerun). case_counts are hand-derived, not emitted by the script.

F5 (minor, accuracy): script comment 'config is covered by critical hashes' is incomplete: grobid-home/config/grobid.properties and resources-registry.json are not among the 8 critical hashes (they are hashed in the manifest and covered by the tree id). host_package_versions omits gettext and brotli although both are in the closure (their dylib sha256 are recorded). gradle.wrapper_distribution keeps the properties escape 'https\://'.

F6 (minor, classification): source_derived.native_binaries embeds host tool output (file, otool, nm, codesign) and oracle_checkout.path/remotes are host facts; these are static inspections of source bytes but are produced by host tools and would be better labelled host-observed.

F7 (process): the limitation 'S1 scope is CRF-first by user decision 2026-11-07' has no record in migration/state/STATUS.md, HANDOFF.md, scope.json or an ADR; it should be recorded before T003 relies on it.

F8 (process): the coordinator branch rust/migration-kit already contains the T000 commits (HEAD cc14c02c8) before review; AGENTS.md says the coordinator integrates reviewed commits. The evidence.json inside the result commit 4382437ae still names result 8b6e922; the corrected packet is in follow-up commit cc14c02c8 (only evidence.json changed), which matches the ledger's submission sha256 6d279f05...
F9 (privacy): committed logs contain hostname (mbenhamd-5.local) and home paths; disclosed by the author. Consider before any push of this fork.
F10 (runtime env, not T000-blocking): pdfalto links Homebrew fontconfig/freetype; fontconfig configuration and installed font set can influence extraction and are not recorded. Track in T003.
limitations: Review reran the same script on the same host and oracle checkout; it confirms reproducibility on this host, not on another machine.
Full object fsck was not run (connectivity-only); critical file and blob identities were checked independently.
No build, server start, or PDF processing was exercised; those belong to T002/T003.
